source_review.review_method: original PDF identity and role validation; complete readable file; real converter return value compared unchanged through provider assembly

pdf.scope: target identity; readable complete PDF; provider assembly; exact converter payload retained

limitations: PDF conversion layout, references, formulas, tables and OCR are excluded.
The existing converter is invoked and its returned text is treated as opaque; comparisons do not rate pymupdf4llm conversion quality.
Unknown historical HTTP status/final URL remain unknown in acquisition/provenance.json.
Supplementary material: same-paper index and links only; removed payloads and placeholder images are not content evidence.
No captured image response with an image media type registered here; image claims are limited to original index/URLs.

pdf.role_evidence: canonical pdf_fallback target identity and complete document; preview/supplementary rejection is covered separately
